summary: Scaffold: git init, Makefile, coco-libs shim, CG3 buff screen in XRoar, CREDITS, README
description:
Gate for everything else. Create the standalone project skeleton in ~/github/bunny on the ~/github/coco Forth toolchain (see PLAN.md, Decisions and Build).

Build:
- git init (commit to the default branch).
- Makefile mirroring coco/make/demo.mk, which cannot be included because it hardcodes ../../ paths. Use COCO ?= $(HOME)/github/coco, FC = python3 $(COCO)/tools/fc.py, kernel map/bin at $(COCO)/kernel/build/kernel.{map,bin} (ROM mode, 32K), built via $(MAKE) -C $(COCO)/kernel when missing.
- build/coco-libs.fs generated by make as absolute INCLUDE lines for $(COCO)/lib/{vdg,wavetable,async-sound,keyboard,rng,bye}.fs. fc.py resolves INCLUDE relative to the including file (tools/fc.py:255), and absolute paths work.
- Targets: all, run (xroar -machine coco2bus -ram 32 -bas ~/.xroar/roms/bas12.rom -extbas ~/.xroar/roms/extbas11.rom -kbd-translate -run bunny.bin, same as demo.mk), cycles (fc.py --cycles), clean.
- bunny.fs: 4 set-sam-v $C8 set-pia (CG3, CSS=1; per coco/src/vdg-modes/vdg-modes.fs:78 which uses V=4 and $C0 for CSS=0), fill the 3072 B CG3 VRAM at vram-base with 00 (buff), loop until BREAK, exit-basic. File must end with a call to main; comments ASCII only.
- CREDITS.md with the required attribution: "PixelFarm (https://bitbucket.org/tebruno99/pixelfarm) Stephen 'Redshrike' Challener", licenses CC-BY 3.0 / CC-BY-SA 3.0 / OGA-BY 3.0, derived frames released CC-BY-SA 3.0.
- README.md: what the demo is, prerequisites (coco checkout, lwasm, XRoar with ROMs, PIL), make run.

Verify: pkill -9 xroar; make run; capture the XRoar window. Done when it shows a solid buff screen (confirms SAM V=4 / $C8).

Follow-up when closing: file an issue in coco for coco-guides/vdg-modes.md:92, whose CG3 SAM V column says 011 but the working code uses 4 (100).

Resolution (2026-09-14): Makefile, build/coco-libs.fs shim, bunny.fs, CREDITS.md, README.md, .gitignore and git init are in place. The shim includes only bye.fs, because bye.fs already INCLUDEs vdg.fs and screen.fs; later issues add wavetable, async-sound, keyboard and rng as they need them. cg3-init uses 4 set-sam-v, vram-base 9 RSHIFT set-sam-f (offset 3), $C8 set-pia, and FILLs 3072 B with 0. App is 309 B at $3000. User confirmed a solid buff screen in XRoar, which confirms SAM V=4 and $C8 for CG3 CSS=1. Not done here: make issues target (#11). Screen capture was blocked by missing Screen Recording permission at the time; the user has since granted it.

summary: png2cg.py converter + frames.json: 8 side-view frames to 2bpp data + preview.png
description:
Depends on #1. Convert the LPC bunny sheet into CG3 sprite data (PLAN.md, Source art and Converter).

- Download https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/bunnysheet5.png into assets/ (321x327 RGBA, not a uniform grid).
- tools/frames.json: crop boxes (x,y,w,h) for the side view. Hop cycle: (28,218,25,27) (59,216,26,28) (91,217,33,28) (134,218,29,25). Sit to munch: (179,218,26,25) (210,221,27,22) (243,224,28,19) (275,224,28,19). Also the color map and sequence names.
- Anchor frames on the shared baseline (sheet y ~245, cell centre x) and store per-frame ox oy so the hop keeps its lift without jitter. Force ox even so 2x output lands on byte boundaries.
- Color map (CSS=1): 00 buff = alpha 0, body (239,233,231), light grey (183,179,178); 01 cyan = outline (58,55,55), mid grey (130,124,124); 10 magenta = pink ear (214,179,157), browns (188,139,109) (196,145,114); 11 orange = tan nose (205,174,103). Nearest-color fallback. This mapping was test-rendered during planning and reads well.
- Pad width to a multiple of 4, pack 2bpp MSB-first. Record = w h ox oy (4 B) then ceil(w/4)*h bytes. ~190 B per frame.
- Emit build/sprites.fs as DATA[PY name bytes.fromhex("...") ]DATA blocks (literal bytes, so no dependence on fc.py cwd; the exec is at tools/fc.py:366) plus a frame pointer table. Wire into the Makefile.
- build/preview.png: every frame at 4x in CG3 CSS=1 colors on buff, grouped by sequence, anchor marked.

Out of scope: patch records and hand-authored frames (#6).
Verify: open preview.png; bunny.fs still compiles with sprites.fs included; check the reported app size.

Progress (2026-09-14): tools/png2cg.py and tools/frames.json written; assets/bunnysheet5.png downloaded (sha256 f6f9d035...6f04). make builds build/sprites.fs and build/preview.png (make preview opens it). 8 frames, 1502 B total, no unmapped colors; app compiles to 1953 B at $3000. Generated Forth: DATA[PY spr-<name> blocks, spr-count, seq-hop/seq-munch index and length CONSTANTs, and spr ( n -- addr ). Anchor = sheet cell left (cell_x in frames.json) + 16 on baseline y=245. Cells: hop 24/56/88/120, munch 176/208/240/272. Observation for #4: hop4 sits about 12 px further forward than the other hop frames (ox -2 vs -12..-14), because the sheet bakes forward motion into that cell. The hop sequence's per-frame dx in #4 has to absorb this or the bunny will jump back when hop1 follows hop4. Fixed during review: the preview clipped hop4, so preview cells are now sized from frame extents. User reviewed preview.png and confirmed colors and alignment look right. Closed.

summary: blit2x CODE word: opaque 2x blit, one static bunny frame on screen
description:
Depends on #2. The core drawing primitive (PLAN.md, Rendering).

- CODE blit2x ( spr x y flags -- ): reads a 1x 2bpp record and writes it opaque at 2x into CG3 VRAM (32 bytes per row, 96 rows). Each source byte expands through a 256-entry table of 16-bit doubled-pixel words; each source row is written to two VRAM rows. x,y are the anchor; apply ox oy.
- Why not the kernel spr-draw (coco/kernel/kernel.asm ~:1980): it treats 00 as transparent and 00 is buff, the bunny body color, so the body would show through. It is also per-pixel and slow.
- CODE words end with ;NEXT and preserve X (IP), U (data stack), S. Clip or document the valid x,y range.

Out of scope: mirroring (flags bit 0, #8) and inline sound sampling (#5).
Verify: draw hop frame 1 at a fixed spot; capture XRoar; it matches preview.png at 2x. Record make cycles cost for the word.

Progress (2026-09-14): CODE blit2x in bunny.fs, with VARIABLEs vram, dbl-tab, blt-dst, blt-w, blt-h. png2cg.py now also emits dbl-table (512 B, hex literal; inline Python in DATA[PY was avoided because fc.py comment stripping eats ( ) there). main draws hop1 anchored at 32,80 and munch1 at 96,80. App 2646 B. fc.py --cycles: blit2x ~261 cy setup + ~92 cy per source row + ~44 cy per source byte, so hop1 (27 rows x 7 B) is ~11,000 cy, about 74% of a 14,917 cy frame. Tearing estimate for #4: CG3 rows are 2 scanlines, so source row k finishes near line 5+7k while the beam reaches it near line 70+2*top+4k; with top=26 the blit stays ahead of the beam for all rows. Inline sound sampling (#5) will shrink this margin. Verification tooling: the XRoar window was on another macOS Space (iTerm2 full screen), so screen-capture could not see it. Added make shot: headless XRoar (-ui null -ao null) traps at the SHOT_AT-th call of kernel CODE_VSYNC (address read from kernel.map), writes a raw .ram dump (XRoar FILETYPE_RAM), and tools/cg3shot.py renders the CG3 page at vram-base to build/shot.png. The shot shows both frames at 2x with correct palette and placement. User confirmed the live XRoar window matches the shot. Closed.

summary: Hop across the screen: frame table, VSYNC loop, trail erase, tearing check
description:
Depends on #3. Retires the biggest timing unknown: whether single-buffer drawing tears.

- Frame table entries (5 B): sprite index, dx, dy, duration (frames), sfx id (0 for now). Terminator byte marks the end of a sequence.
- Main loop: vsync, draw what changed, advance animation. Hop frames 1-4 cycling, moving right with dx per hop, wrap or stop at the edge. Ground around row 88.
- Trail erase: clear only the strip uncovered by dx with spr-erase-box (clears to 00 = buff), or a local opaque clear.
- Timing: after VSYNC there are 70 lines before row 0 (kernel WAIT-PAST-ROW). Keep the bunny low enough that the blit finishes above the beam. Measure with make cycles.
- If it tears: switch to a page flip using the second CG3 page inside the kernel-reserved $0600-$1DFF (6144 B = two 3072 B pages), following coco/src/clock/clock.fs set-sam-f-fast (:74) and flip-state (:136). Record which approach was chosen and why in this issue.

Verify: several XRoar captures taken at random moments while hopping; no tearing or leftover pixels.

summary: Sound in the loop: fill-to-vsync, inline sampling in blit2x, hop boing
description:
Depends on #4. Retires the second unknown: sound pitch holding while drawing (PLAN.md, Rendering and Sound).

- Background: coco/lib/async-sound.fs is one phase-accumulator voice on the $FF20 DAC, one sample per HSYNC by polling (interrupts are masked). freq>inc assumes ~262 samples per frame, so fewer samples lower the pitch. The sample demo loop 240 snd-fill (coco/src/sound-async/sound-async.fs main) runs slightly flat.
- CODE fill-to-vsync: copy of snd-fill (async-sound.fs:168) that emits one sample per HSYNC until the $FF03 VSYNC flag is set, then returns. It should also wait correctly when the voice is idle. A noise twin modeled on snd-noise-fill (:244).
- blit2x: inside the byte loop, test $FF01 and run an inline copy of the snd-poll sample body (async-sound.fs:104). snd-poll itself ends in ;NEXT and cannot be called from CODE.
- Main loop: BEGIN fill-to-vsync draw-dirty snd-frame anim-tick ... UNTIL.
- Boing on hop takeoff: sine wavetable (lib/wavetable.fs gen-sine into heap), snd-note with an upward snd-slide!, reversed at the apex frame via the sfx byte.

Verify: a held 440 Hz test note sounds the same idle and while the bunny hops (by ear in XRoar); boing plays on each hop with no dropouts; captures still show no tearing.
Follow-up when closing: file an issue in coco proposing fill-to-vsync for lib/async-sound.fs.

summary: Hand-authored art: carrot 0-3, nose wiggle patch, yawn, sleep, z
description:
Depends on #2. The sheet only has hop and grass-munch frames; these are drawn by hand (PLAN.md, Source art).

- assets/extra/*.png using only the 4 CG3 colors (or source colors that map cleanly): carrot0-3 (whole to eaten, ~12x16, orange body, cyan top), sleep (munch-low pose, eye closed), yawn, nose wiggle (1-2 px nose change on the sitting frame), z glyph.
- Converter: add patch records (row col len bytes) against a base frame for wiggle and closed-eye variants to save memory; add the new frames to frames.json and preview.png.

Verify: preview.png shows each new frame at 4x next to its base frame; app size still within the ROM-mode budget (~10K).

summary: Animation state machine: idle, wiggle, hop, eat carrot, yawn, sleep, wake
description:
Depends on #4 and #6. Sequence the whole demo (PLAN.md, Animation engine).

- A state VARIABLE and an IF chain (fc.py has no WHILE/REPEAT or CASE).
- Loop: idle -> nose wiggle x2 -> hop right -> carrot appears -> munch frames 5-8 while the carrot steps 3/2/1/0 per bite -> yawn -> sleep with z rising through 3 positions -> wake -> (hop back is #8) -> repeat.
- Carrot and z are separate small blits, redrawn only when they change.

Verify: XRoar captures of each state; the full loop runs several times without drift or leftover pixels.

summary: Mirrored blit and hop back to the left
description:
Depends on #3 and #7. flags bit 0 in blit2x mirrors the sprite using a 256-entry reverse-byte table (2bpp pairs reversed) plus reversed byte order per row, with ox negated. Add a hop-left sequence so the loop returns the bunny to its start.

Verify: capture a left-facing frame and compare to a flipped preview.png; loop closes cleanly.

summary: Remaining sound effects: sniff, crunch, snore, wake chirp
description:
Depends on #5 and #7. Map sfx ids in the frame tables to effects (PLAN.md, Sound).

- Sniff during wiggle: short noise bursts with rests.
- Crunch per bite: ~5 frames of noise with decaying amp (pattern in coco/src/sound-async/sound-async.fs main loop).
- Snore: 3 snd-shape (triangle), low note, snd-env! swell then fade, repeating in step with the z.
- Wake chirp: short sine with a rising slide.

Verify: listen in XRoar through a full loop; each sound lines up with its animation.

summary: Polish: random idle times, BREAK exit, README screenshot
description:
Depends on #7. Idle duration from RND (60-180 frames, coco lib/rng.fs or kernel RND); BREAK restores text mode and calls exit-basic cleanly with the DAC at midpoint; add an XRoar capture to README.md.

Verify: BREAK returns to the BASIC OK prompt; README renders with the screenshot.

summary: issues.html view: tools/issues_html.py and make issues target
description:
Depends on #1. tools/issues_html.py was copied from the issues skill and issues.html generated when the tracker was created. Add a make issues target running: python3 tools/issues_html.py render issues.jsonl issues.html roadmap.jsonl --title="bunny issues". Commit issues.html (do not gitignore it).

Verify: headless Chrome --dump-dom shows one article.card per issue and one li.step per roadmap entry.
